Best of Thailand 2026
the year’s best to eat, drink, stay & see
intro: The best of Thailand for 2026, gathered on one page — drawn from our own verified rankings and global awards like the MICHELIN Guide and Asia's 50 Best Bars. Every category has a standout pick with a link to the full guide.
quickAnswerHtml: The best of Thailand in 2026: eat at Sorn and Sühring, the two three-Michelin-star restaurants · drink at Bar Us, No.4 on Asia's 50 Best Bars · street food in Yaowarat · rooftops in Bangkok · temples at the Grand Palace · plus islands and stays across all 77 provinces

blocks.text: The best of Thailand 2026 — by category

items.name: 🍽️ Best fine dining
items.blurb: Sorn & Sühring — Thailand's only two three-Michelin-star restaurants in 2026 — deep-rooted Southern Thai and contemporary German omakase

items.name: 🍸 Best cocktail bar
items.blurb: Bar Us — No.4 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2025 and the best bar in Thailand

items.name: 🍜 Best street-food street
items.blurb: Yaowarat (Chinatown) — Bangkok's legendary street-food strip — heritage shops, noodles, sweets and late-night seafood

items.name: 🌆 Best rooftop bars
items.blurb: Bangkok skybars — A world capital of rooftop bars — Chao Phraya river views and the Sukhumvit skyline at sunset

items.name: 🛕 Best temples & culture
items.blurb: Grand Palace & Wat Phra Kaew — Bangkok's historic heart — Thailand's most important temple and the Emerald Buddha

items.name: 🏝️ Best islands & beaches
items.blurb: Thailand’s islands — From Phuket, Krabi and Samui to Koh Kood and Koh Lipe — pick the right island with our destination guides

items.name: 🏨 Best places to stay
items.blurb: City-by-city stays — Hotel reviews and ranked stays across all 77 provinces, with real prices and direct booking links

blocks.html: Every pick here comes from one of two places: (1) officially announced global awards such as the MICHELIN Guide Thailand 2026 and Asia's 50 Best Bars 2025, and (2) our own rankings compiled from multiple real reviews, real prices and fact-checking. We never crown a winner we can't back with data — where there's no clear single winner, we link to the ranking so you can choose by your own taste.

blocks.title: 🔄 Refreshed every year
blocks.html: This page is refreshed each year as the awards land (MICHELIN late in the year, 50 Best mid-year). Bookmark it and come back for next year’s edition.

faq.q: What is Best of Thailand 2026 based on?
faq.a: It draws on officially announced global awards (MICHELIN Guide Thailand 2026, Asia's 50 Best Bars 2025) combined with ThailandAddict's own rankings, compiled from real reviews, real prices and fact-checking.

faq.q: What is Thailand's best restaurant in 2026?
faq.a: By the top award, the two three-Michelin-star restaurants: Sorn (Southern Thai) and Sühring (contemporary German omakase), both in Bangkok.

faq.q: What is the best bar in Thailand?
faq.a: Bar Us in Bangkok took No.4 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2025 and was the best bar in Thailand that year.

faq.q: How often is this page updated?
faq.a: It is refreshed every year as the major awards are announced — MICHELIN late in the year and Asia’s 50 Best Bars mid-year.
